mission: A single Sim is a person, not a factory: wellbeing, fun, social time and temperament precede discretionary money throughput. More Sims permit distinct, fair and capacity-aware collaboration, provided each stays healthy and retains their own goals.

admission.roster: exact locally attested original ordered roster; fingerprint must equal current independent observer
admission.capture: same unique active capture for all members and tasks

SOLO_WELLBEING_FIRST.meaning: Only one actor; each member's six needs and emotional state take priority over discretionary work

COOPERATIVE_HOUSEHOLD.meaning: Allocate at most one independently observed task per member, choosing current stable members by skill and preference then lower recent verified workload; do not infer productivity

task_origins: Must be observed as truly available via existing domain owners; only source-present registry mechanics may be proposed. No guessed queue identities, resources, salaries or output.

output.assigned: one non-actuating proposal per eligible member
output.deferred: all unassigned task IDs and reasons remain visible
output.money: no numeric yield without later independent verified outcome

continuation.outcome: Require distinct current proof_ref, exact task id and current capture; failed tasks held for replan
continuation.registry: Append missing mechanics to canonical registry in separate consulted revision, never silently treat gap as supported

portrait_handoff.trigger: Immediately when the selected member is observed ASLEEP/RECHARGING/AWAY, even with no tasks; optionally on verified current-capture completed needs review of the selected AWAKE member. Also on selected AT_WORK only when same-capture work_shift reports verified rabbit-hole employment and career tone decision permits handoff.
portrait_handoff.target: Next explicitly AWAKE, non-player-reserved, queue-verified roster member in original portrait order, wrapping once and never selecting the source; not dependent on skill, chores or discretionary yield eligibility.
portrait_handoff.effect: Policy only. A real native portrait selection needs independently certified current-patch EA hook; subsequent observation of selected identity and per-Sim needs must use a fresh capture before needs/queue work. No gameplay effect or click authority from this plan.
portrait_handoff.rotation: Single proposal per source capture; optional attention_review requires member_key, capture_ref, unique evidence proof_ref and state VERIFIED_COMPLETE. No timer, background loop, repeated blind click, or repeated rotation on old proof. A promotion-ready Work Hard candidate is a pre-handoff barrier; an actual new capture must show Work Hard active before at-work handoff, or a safe decline yields immediate rotation.
portrait_handoff.legacy: No selected_member_key and no verified attention_review leave ordinary task allocations unchanged; no handoff.

work_shift.work_tone_first: A recommended Work Hard tone defers portrait handoff until independently observed. Already-active Work Hard, unmet or unknown promotion readiness, unsafe welfare, protected player tone or unavailable tone cause no work-tone effect; an observed ordinary rabbit-hole worker can then release the portrait.
work_shift.active_career: ACTIVE_CAREER and UNKNOWN career modes do NOT release the selected actor
